Essex DELUXE 1 Speed City Bikes
The DELUXE edition adds special cup holder + Custom Color Matched rear rack. Classic, Stylish, Comfortable, Sweet and simple, low-maintenance one speed town and city bikes. Super-efficient road-worthy tires; wide enough for softening most town bumps. The most comfy position. Cruise back to school at campus, town or neighborhood. Finely Crafted of durable, comfortable 4130 CroMo. Stylish custom color matched fenders and chain-guard. Brown stitched grips and matching saddle.
